problem: Dynamic readiness rejects real opportunity-return/v1 documents whose state is DONE because isQualifyingReturn only accepts states containing RETURN. A real CONTROL_PLAN truth dependency currently has a durable return document with state DONE and a same-run lifecycle document with state DONE, yet the evaluator cannot classify that pair as SATISFIED. This can falsely keep dependency-gated S2/local integration work blocked even when its terminal positive evidence exists.
acceptance: Actual opportunity-return/v1 state DONE paired to a same-run DONE lifecycle run is accepted as qualifying positive return evidence.
Negative, conflict, boundary, mismatched-run, return-without-DONE and DONE-without-return evidence still fail closed.
Regression tests use actual repository-shaped surface return documents and prove at least one S2 local integration can derive READY_DERIVED when all dependencies are terminal-positive.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority is promoted by the repair.
title: Align dynamic readiness with real return states
mission: Repair the dependency-evidence classifier so its positive-return predicate matches the repository's actual opportunity-return/v1 lifecycle encoding, then prove the fix against real-shaped S2 evidence without weakening negative/conflict/authority gates.

unblock_value.reason: S2 local integrations are dependency-gated on exact RETURN+DONE evidence; a classifier/schema mismatch can suppress all otherwise-ready local integration lanes.

incident_repair.reason: The mismatch is reproduced on durable repository bytes: the return and matching run for CONTROL_PLAN truth are both DONE, while isQualifyingReturn only accepts state text containing RETURN.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Correct automatic readiness prevents the global guide or human from manually interpreting completed dependencies and hand-routing S2 work.

regression_prevention.reason: Repository-shaped tests can lock the actual return-state contract and prevent future evaluator/schema drift from silently blocking the swarm.

falsification: A real-shaped opportunity-return/v1 document with state DONE plus its same-run DONE lifecycle run still classifies as unsatisfied.
The repair accepts a negative/conflicted/boundary return as positive evidence.
The repair accepts a DONE run paired to a return from a different run_id.
An S2 gate is declared ready from directory existence alone rather than exact terminal evidence.
The repair implies or mutates Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority.
dedup_note: Current prepared queues already contain the original Dynamic Readiness build but not a repair lane for this reproduced schema/predicate mismatch. Recent discovery proposals cover version coherence, EPOCH/work-packet freshness, recovery arbitration, worker supply and claim/proposal observability; repository search found no proposal targeting DONE-valued opportunity-return evidence being rejected by the readiness classifier.
